plugin.name: Project Planner
plugin.description: Plan projects from your Markdown tasks

commands.insert_filter_as_code_block: Insert current filter as embedded graph

view.title: Project graph
view.dataview_required: Project Planner requires the Dataview plugin to be installed and enabled.
view.dataview_not_installed: The Dataview plugin is not currently installed.
view.dataview_disabled: The Dataview plugin is installed but not enabled.
view.visit_community_plugins: Visit the Community Plugins section in Settings to install or enable Dataview.

gantt.export_desc: Save the chart as an image to paste into a document
gantt.export_empty: There is nothing on the chart to export
gantt.export_failed: The chart could not be exported
gantt.export_done_copied: Saved {{file}} ({{width}}×{{height}}) and copied it to the clipboard
gantt.export_modal_desc: A plain, print-ready picture of the chart as it stands — the same rows, order and filters, with the whole timeline fitted to one landscape page.
gantt.export_modal_paper_desc: The shape the picture is laid out for
gantt.export_modal_quality_desc: Pixels per point. 3× is print quality on A4.
gantt.export_modal_today_desc: Draw a line down the chart at today's date. Worth turning off for a plan that has not started, or a picture that will be read later.
gantt.empty: No tasks found in your vault
gantt.empty_filtered: No tasks match the current search
gantt.bar_tooltip: {{start}} to {{end}} — drag to move, drag an edge to resize
gantt.bar_inferred_tooltip: Suggested {{start}} to {{end}} — not saved yet; drag to schedule
gantt.inferred_hint: {{n}} tasks have suggested dates (dashed). Drag one, or use Apply suggested dates, to write them to your notes.
gantt.apply_inferred_desc: Write every suggested date to its note
gantt.applied_inferred_partial: Scheduled {{n}} tasks, {{failed}} could not be written
gantt.resize_columns: Drag to resize the task column
gantt.sort_by_date_desc: Draw every row flat and earliest first, ignoring nesting and the manual order
gantt.sort_by_date_off_desc: Stop sorting and put the nesting and your own row order back
gantt.reorder_locked: Rows are sorted by date — turn that off to rearrange them
gantt.add_task_desc: Add a task at the end of the list
gantt.add_task_after: Add a task after this one
gantt.linking_hint: Linking from "{{task}}" — click the task it should block.
gantt.skip_weekends_desc: Measure durations in working days and keep bars off weekends: a task starting Friday that takes 4 days ends the following Wednesday
gantt.multiselect_hint: Ctrl-click to select several tasks, then drag any one of them to move them all
gantt.moved_together_hint: {{n}} tasks selected — drag any one of them to move them all
gantt.cascade_held: {{n}} stopped short at an earlier task
gantt.cascade_skipped: {{n}} suggested dates left as they were
gantt.cascade_skipped_done: {{n}} finished tasks left as they were
gantt.tag_failed: Could not update the task tags
gantt.show_in_map: Show this task on the map
gantt.add_milestone_desc: Mark a named day across the timeline
gantt.milestone_tooltip: {{label}} — {{date}}. Drag to move it, click to edit.
gantt.milestone_modal_display_desc: A flag in the band above the chart, or a row among the tasks
gantt.critical_path_desc: Pick out the chain of tasks that decides the finish date, and show how much slack the rest have
gantt.critical_path_hint: Plan finishes {{finish}} — {{n}} tasks on the critical path have no slack.
gantt.at_risk_hint: {{n}} tasks need attention: overdue, never started, or scheduled before what they wait on.
gantt.tooltip_critical: On the critical path — no slack
gantt.tooltip_behind: {{n}} days later than the plan allows
gantt.tooltip_shift_drag: Shift-drag to move every later task with it
gantt.collapse: Collapse the tasks inside this one
gantt.expand: Show the tasks inside this one
gantt.parent_modal_none: No parent — leave this task on its own
gantt.parent_modal_placeholder: Pick the task "{{task}}" should sit inside
gantt.parent_cleared: "{{task}}" no longer sits inside another task
gantt.parent_failed: Could not change which task this one sits inside
gantt.bar_summary_tooltip: {{start}} to {{end}} — the span of the tasks inside this one

kanban.empty: No tasks found in your vault
kanban.empty_filtered: No tasks match the current search
kanban.add_task_desc: Add a task to your default note
kanban.add_card_here: Add a card to this column
kanban.column_read_only: Cards can be reordered here, but this grouping cannot be changed by dragging
kanban.read_only_grouping: Dragging between columns is off for this grouping
kanban.card_hint: Drag to move, double-click to edit
kanban.undo_sort: sorted the cards by due date
kanban.status_failed: Could not change the task status
kanban.tag_failed: Could not update the task tags

open_questions.empty: No open questions in your vault
open_questions.empty_hint: Write [oq:: your question] on a line of its own in any note, and it will appear here.
open_questions.empty_filtered: No questions match the current search
open_questions.answer_hint: Enter to save, Shift+Enter for a new line
open_questions.stale_line: That question has changed in {{note}} — reload to see it as it is now

task_edit.text_locked: This task is a whole note — rename the note to rename the task
task_edit.dates_locked: These dates come from the tasks inside this one
task_edit.dates_suggested: Suggested {{start}} to {{end}} — saving writes them to the note
task_edit.progress_desc: How far along the task is, 0 to 100. Leave empty for none.
task_edit.no_note: No note yet — properties stay on the task line
task_edit.note_failed: Could not create the task note
task_edit.problem_dates_backwards: The end date is before the start date

task_create.no_target_note: Open a note first, or add a task to one, so Project Planner knows where to write
task_create.could_not_read: That task could not be read back — nothing was changed
task_create.insert_failed: Could not put that task into the chain
task_create.chain_healed: Reconnected {{n}} links around the deleted task

retrofit.title: Create notes for existing tasks
retrofit.body: This will create up to {{n}} notes in "{{folder}}", rewrite those task lines to link to them, and move every task property into the note it links to. The checkbox, the link and the dates stay on the line.
retrofit.nothing_to_do: There are no inline tasks to give notes to
retrofit.done: Linked {{n}} tasks to their notes and moved the properties of {{moved}}
retrofit.done_partial: Linked {{n}} tasks and moved the properties of {{moved}}; {{skipped}} could not be updated

settings.show_task_priorities_desc: Display priority indicators on task nodes
settings.show_status_counts_desc: Display a status counts overlay on the canvas
settings.gantt_show_warnings_desc: Display warning markers on at-risk task rows and the summary line below the Gantt chart
settings.edge_style_desc: The line style used for connections between nodes
settings.smooth_step_radius_desc: Border radius for smooth step corners (0 = sharp right angles)
settings.tag_color_palette_desc: Choose a color theme for tags
settings.tag_colors_desc: Assign a fixed color to a tag. Tags set to "Theme color" follow the palette above.
settings.tag_colors_reset_desc: Clear every manually assigned tag color
settings.no_tags_found: No tags found in your tasks yet
settings.linking_style_desc: How task dependencies are specified in simple tasks
settings.linking_individual_desc: Each dependency with its own emoji identifier
settings.linking_dataview_desc: Dependencies using Dataview inline field syntax
settings.debug_visualization_desc: Show additional debug information in the graph view
settings.language_desc: Select the language for the plugin interface
settings.companion_notes: Create a note for each new task
settings.companion_notes_desc: New tasks are written as a link to their own note, so there is always somewhere to keep the detail. Existing tasks are left alone.
settings.finance_enabled_desc: Track hours, people and costs on tasks, and show the finance dashboard
settings.finance_rate_note_desc: Note holding the grade-to-rate and person-to-grade tables
settings.finance_rate_note_missing: No rates note yet — create one to start pricing tasks
settings.finance_default_hours_desc: Hours a person works in a day when a task does not say otherwise
settings.finance_currency_desc: Currency costs are shown in; rates in the note are plain numbers
settings.finance_include_inferred_desc: Count tasks whose Gantt dates were suggested rather than written
settings.task_source_desc: Which part of the vault every view reads tasks from, written as a Dataview FROM source. Leave empty for the whole vault.

controls.title: View
controls.open_gantt_desc: Open the Gantt view for these tasks
controls.undo_desc: Take back the last change made in either view
controls.fit_view_desc: Zoom out until every task fits on screen
controls.reload_desc: Read the tasks in your vault again
controls.open_kanban_desc: Open the board view for these tasks

unlinked_panel.title: Unlinked tasks
unlinked_panel.drag_hint: Drag a task onto the graph to place it

graph.no_tasks_hint: No tasks found in your vault.
graph.all_unlinked_hint: Drag tasks from the panel on the left onto the graph to place them here.

errors.cannot_insert_task_between_non_dataview: Insert task between edges is only supported for Dataview tasks.

embed.dataview_required: Project Planner requires the Dataview plugin.

finance.modal_schedule_suggested: Dates suggested, not yet written — {{days}} days
finance.modal_hours_per_day_desc: Leave empty to use the default from settings
finance.modal_total_hours_desc: Overrides the daily rate when set
finance.modal_line_crowded: This task's line is getting long — consider giving it a note
finance.write_failed: Could not write the finance data to that task
finance.day_mode_desc: How the Gantt counts days, which changes every hours-per-day figure
finance.kpi_total_caveat: {{amount}} of this rests on {{count}} tasks with suggested dates
finance.kpi_total_excluded: {{amount}} more sits on {{count}} tasks with suggested dates
finance.kpi_hours_unpriced: {{hours}} h have no rate behind them
finance.spread_note: Each task cost is spread evenly across the days of its bar
finance.issue_unknown-person: {{count}} allocations to somebody not in the rates note
finance.issue_no-rate: {{count}} allocations whose grade has no rate
finance.issue_allocations-off: {{count}} tasks whose shares do not total 100%
finance.issue_no-allocations: {{count}} tasks with hours but nobody on them
finance.issue_rate_note: {{count}} rows in the rates note could not be read
finance.rate_problem_duplicate-grade: Duplicate grade, the first was kept
finance.rate_problem_duplicate-person: Duplicate person, the first was kept
finance.rate_problem_unknown-grade: Grade is not in the rates table
finance.no_rate_note: No rates note at {{path}}, so nothing can be priced
finance.rate_note_failed: Could not create the rates note

handover.modal_desc: One searchable PDF holding the plan, the tasks, the open questions and the vault's notes — for somebody who does not use Obsidian.
handover.modal_heading_desc: Printed on the cover and used for the file name.
handover.modal_notes_desc: Renders every note into an appendix, with links between them kept working inside the PDF. Turn off for the plan alone.
handover.modal_finance_desc: Adds the totals, the breakdown by person and project, and the biggest cost drivers.
handover.modal_today_desc: Turn off for a plan being handed over before it starts, where a “today” line would claim more than it should.
handover.done: Handover pack written to {{path}} — {{tasks}} tasks, {{notes}} notes
handover.done_html: Could not reach the PDF printer, so the document was written to {{path}}. Open it in a browser and print it to PDF.
handover.failed: The handover pack could not be created
handover.empty: There is nothing to export yet — no tasks and no notes
handover.overview_inferred_warning: {{n}} tasks carry no dates of their own. The dates shown for them were worked out from what blocks them, and are a proposal rather than a commitment — they are marked as suggested wherever they appear.
handover.overview_how_to_read_body: Every task has an ID, and that ID is what the dependency columns and the diagrams refer to. Links inside this document work: the contents page, the cross-references between notes, and the questions' “raised in” links all jump to the right page.
handover.register_days: days of slack before the finish date moves
handover.dependencies_chain_of: Chain {{n}} — {{count}} tasks. Arrows run from a task to the work that waits on it.
handover.dependencies_isolated_desc: These block nothing and wait for nothing, so they can be done at any point in the plan.
handover.dependencies_legend_loop: Dashed: closes a loop, which is a mistake in the plan
handover.dependencies_empty: No task in this vault depends on another.
handover.finance_inferred_note: {{amount}} of this total sits on {{n}} tasks whose dates were estimated rather than written down. Treat that part as indicative.
handover.finance_empty: Nothing in this vault has been costed.
handover.issue_unknown_person: {{person}} is not in the rates note
handover.issue_allocations_off: the shares on this task total {{total}}%, not 100%
handover.issue_no_allocations: hours are recorded but nobody is allocated
handover.issue_inferred_schedule: the cost rests on estimated dates

task_source.invalid: Project Planner: Dataview could not read the task source {{source}}. Check its syntax.
